criteria.reason: Response is entirely in Italian as requested.
Figures are wrong: 2-3% and 35,000-60,000, not about 0.5% main-language speakers.
Misstates constitutional status as official national language with others; omits contact-only official status.
Inconsistent with required twin facts on speakers and constitutional status.

factual_errors: Romansh speakers are about 40,000 main-language speakers (0.5%), not 2-3% of population.
Romansh is not an official language of the Confederation on equal terms in all contexts; only in contact with Romansh speakers.
summary: The response is in Italian but gives inaccurate speaker figures and misstates Romansh's constitutional status.
